title: ArtForge - a free AI game-art studio that runs 100% on your own PC
author: couldgiveaflyingfck
selftext:
# ArtForge - A Free AI Game-Art Studio That Runs 100% on Your Own PC

No cloud. No subscription. No ads. Your GPU, your art, your machine.

# 🎨 MAKE ART

* Type an idea, hit Generate, and pick your favorites. Choose between fast drafts and full-quality paintings.
* Five quality levels - 8-bit, 16-bit, 32-bit, Painted, and Showpiece.
* **AI Art Director** \- checks every picture and quietly redraws the duds.
* **Art Styles + My Look** \- teach it your personal style once, and it carries that look into every picture.
* **Mystery Button** \- one click, secret prompts, and completely unexpected artwork.

# ⚔️ MAGIC KEYS

Type one word and generate an entire batch.

* **Weapon** \- legendary swords, dagger pairs, axes, and bows. Ruby blades, ivory and elk-horn hilts, gem-eyed skulls, and 36 creature families ranging from wolves to krakens.
* **Goodie** \- glossy candy, fruit, treasure, and collectible pickups.
* **Rig + Animate** \- create characters, animate running, jumping, shooting, and export directly to sprite sheets.

# 🧊 TURN IT 3D

* Turn almost any picture into a textured 3D model, inspected from all four sides.
* Rig it, animate it, spin it around any point, and experiment with Metal and Jade appearances.
* Export GLB / OBJ for Blender, Godot, Unity, and Unreal.

# 🕹️ EXPORT EVERYWHERE

* **Amiga** \- real IFF files and palettes for the A500 (32 colors) and A1200 (256 colors).
* **Apple** \- u/2x/u/3x image sets, complete app icon sets, SpriteKit atlases, and USDZ 3D.
* **Game development** \- sprite sheets, GIFs, palettes, game-engine folders, and app icons.
* **3D printing** \- repaired STL and color 3MF, with flat bases and dimensions specified in millimeters.

# 🔧 EXTRAS

* Built-in one-button recorder for tiny, razor-sharp AV1 screen recordings.
* Dark, OLED-friendly interface.
* Keyboard shortcuts throughout the application.

Still in the forge, and there's plenty more cooking.

Feedback, suggestions, and constructive criticism are welcome. Be gentle, though. It bites.

# 🚀 COMING SOON

A few things currently cooking in the forge -

* **MCP Bridge** \- Connect ArtForge to Claude and other AI assistants. Ask your AI to create a batch of game artwork, and ArtForge handles the generation, organization, file management, and exports. All locally, on your own machine.
* **16-bit Pixel Fighters** \- Create a hero and generate an entire animated sprite sheet in one go. Running, jumping, swinging, blocking, and more.
* **Armor Key** \- Generate complete armor sets, including helmets, breastplates, and shields. Front and back views, designed with 3D conversion in mind.

Still building. More surprises coming.
